claims.why: main() calls run_tier1(tasks) unconditionally at line 115.

claims.text: --arms adds the deterministic A/B/C retrieval comparison (also no LLM).
claims.why: main() calls run_arms(tasks) only if args.arms is True (line 116).

claims.text: Tier 2 runs only with --tier2 AND a reachable provider; otherwise it is skipped with a clear message.
claims.why: This chunk does not contain run_tier2's implementation; cannot verify the 'clear message' part. The condition --tier2 is checked at line 117.

claims.text: --gate is an ADVISORY local regression check against baseline.json -- see daedalus.eval.harness.run_gate.
claims.why: main() calls harness.run_gate() when --gate is passed (line 112).

claims.text: It is never wired into anything automatic; run it by hand before shipping a slice-heuristic change.
claims.why: No automatic invocation of --gate in this file; only manual CLI flag.

claims.text: --update-baseline is the only thing that writes baseline.json, and only when explicitly passed.
claims.why: main() calls harness.write_baseline() only when --update-baseline is passed (line 108). No other code in this file writes baseline.json.

claims.text: --mint-commit/--confirm-mint are the ONLY entry points that persist a task to the mint store (daedalus.eval.mint.DEFAULT_MINT_STORE_PATH); every other flag above only READS it via harness.all_tasks().
claims.why: Only --mint-commit and --confirm-mint call add_minted_task/confirm_minted_task (lines 92, 101). Other flags call all_tasks() (line 68) which only reads.

claims.text: This is the human-invoked half of the mint -> quarantine -> confirm -> primary flywheel -- there is no automatic caller (offload.py does not invoke this today; see mint.py's module docstring).
claims.why: This chunk does not contain offload.py or mint.py; cannot verify absence of automatic caller.

claims.text: Output is ASCII-only for a raw Windows console.
claims.why: _print_ascii() (line 33-37) catches UnicodeEncodeError and writes ASCII replacement.

claims.text: --gate ... Exits non-zero on a regression; never blocks anything automatic.

claims.why: write_baseline() called only when --update-baseline is passed (line 108).

claims.text: --mint-commit ... persist it to the mint store so it joins every subsequent run via all_tasks().
claims.why: add_minted_task() is called (line 92), and all_tasks() reads the store.
This chunk does not contain MINT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD; cannot verify promotion logic.
main() sets repo = args.repo or AGENT_ENV_ROOT (line 88).

observations.what: _print_ascii catches UnicodeEncodeError but not other encoding errors (e.g., LookupError)
mint_from_commit returns None or list; if None, code prints message and returns 1, but does not differentiate between 'unresolvable ref' and 'no unit-level change'
